products.name: Solène Teardrop Pendant
products.short: A single teardrop crystal on a fine 18k gold-plated chain — made to catch every light in the room.
products.description: Solène is the necklace you forget you're wearing until someone stops you to ask about it. A hand-set AAA cubic zirconia teardrop, cut with 57 facets, hangs from a 45 cm cable chain with a 5 cm extender. The 18k gold PVD plating is waterproof and tarnish-resistant, so it goes from shower to dinner without coming off.

products.name: Milano Paperclip Chain
products.short: The chunky-but-light paperclip chain that anchors every layered look.
products.description: Milano is the base layer of almost every stack we style. Elongated links give it presence without weight, and the polished finish throws light as you move. Wear it alone, or under Solène for the look that went viral on our TikTok.

products.name: Riviera Tennis Necklace
products.short: A continuous line of 4 mm stones. Red-carpet sparkle, everyday price.
products.description: Riviera is our most-saved piece. Sixty-two prong-set 4 mm stones in rhodium-plated settings create an unbroken line of light. A secure box clasp with safety latch keeps it where it belongs.

products.name: Ember Ruby Heart
products.short: A ruby-red heart on a satellite chain. The gift that says it for you.
products.description: Ember pairs a lab-created ruby-red heart with a delicate satellite chain. It arrives in our signature red box, which makes it our most-gifted piece for anniversaries and Valentine's Day.

products.name: Luna Huggie Hoops
products.short: Pavé huggies that hug the lobe and never come off.
products.description: Luna's pavé row sits right against the lobe, so the stones catch light from every angle. The hinged click-closure is secure enough to sleep in.

products.name: Aurora Crystal Drops
products.short: Long, light, swinging drops — they move every time you turn your head.
products.description: Aurora is made for movement. A cascade of three graduated crystals swings from a gold-plated stud, scattering light with every step.

products.name: Petal Pearl Studs
products.short: Freshwater pearls in a gold halo. Quiet luxury.
products.description: Petal sets a 7 mm freshwater pearl inside a fine gold-plated halo. Classic enough for the office, soft enough for a wedding.

products.name: Eternity Band
products.short: A full circle of stones. The band every stack is built around.
products.description: Eternity is channel-set with stones all the way around, so it sparkles no matter how it turns on your finger. Stack it with Halo and Signet for our signature three-ring look.

products.name: Halo Solitaire
products.short: A 1.5 ct-look oval surrounded by a ring of light.
products.description: Halo puts a brilliant oval centre stone inside a pavé frame, so it reads bigger and brighter than it is. Rhodium plated for a cool, white-metal shine.

products.name: Scarlet Signet
products.short: A polished signet with a deep red stone. A little power dressing for every day.
products.description: The Scarlet Signet is our boldest ring: a polished oval face holding a single deep-red stone, a little bit of power dressing for every day.

products.name: Celeste Tennis Bracelet
products.short: A line of light around the wrist. The bracelet that gets photographed.
products.description: Celeste sets 3 mm stones in a flexible line that follows the wrist. It's the piece that shows up most in our customers' unboxing videos.

products.name: Torque Cuff
products.short: A sculptural open cuff with a mirror finish.
products.description: Torque is a single sculpted line of polished metal. It opens to slip on and holds its shape, and it pairs well with Celeste for a high-contrast wrist stack.

products.name: Figaro Chain Bracelet
products.short: The Italian classic link, three short and one long.
products.description: Figaro's rhythmic link is a timeless Italian design. It's light enough to stack three deep and polished enough to wear alone.

products.name: The Layering Edit
products.short: Solène + Milano + Riviera, pre-styled. The full TikTok look in one box.
products.description: The three necklaces from our most-watched layering video, sized to sit perfectly at 40, 42 and 45 cm. Each is wrapped separately inside our signature red box, so there are no tangles.

products.name: The Stack Trio
products.short: Eternity + Halo + Scarlet Signet. A ready-made ring stack.
products.description: Our three bestselling rings, chosen to stack with no gaps. Pick one size and we'll match all three.

products.name: Midnight Gift Box
products.short: Petal Pearl Studs + Ember Ruby Heart in one keepsake box.
products.description: Our most-unboxed set: a matching pearl and ruby-heart pairing that arrives in the red box with gold foil, satin ribbon and a handwritten card.
